The Lodgify Public API is a REST interface for the Lodgify vacation rental platform. It exposes properties and room types, availability calendars, daily rates, rate settings, priced quotes, the full booking and reservation lifecycle, guest messaging threads, and webhook subscriptions. The API spans two versions (v1 and v2) under the host https://api.lodgify.com and is authenticated with an X-ApiKey request header.
